I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the hub replacement in Zoom Room B is IT ticket #4092.

I got this from #north-random, a channel Dana is in. Ilse posted it there yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55), and said the ticket is open to replace the hub. I also passed on her warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, or the Polycom resets.

That's the only mention I found, and I didn't see the ticket itself, so I can't say whether it's still open. The knowledge base search ran in keyword-only mode, so it may have missed other mentions worded differently.
